d: Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Marketing teams build brand love and drive growth across a global, three-sided marketplace, reaching millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

We’re looking for a Marketing Executive, Restaurant Marketing to join our Marketing team in Kuwait. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us grow awareness, demand and orders by delivering best-in-class co-marketing and promotional programmes with our restaurant partners across Kuwait.
q: Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
5+ years of marketing experience, preferably in FMCG or F&B, with eCommerce and/or restaurant marketing experience prioritised
Proven experience in multi-channel marketing, data-informed decision making and performance-based marketing, with knowledge of B2B2C marketing and the Kuwait F&B scene
Strong analytical skills, including advanced Google Sheets/Excel, data dashboards and budget management, with a meticulous eye for detail and data integrity
Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships with partners, agencies and internal teams
Strong learning agility and the ability to prioritise high-impact work, manage multiple projects with minimal oversight, and deliver under pressure and tight timelines
Good written and spoken English and Arabic
Experience using and optimising AI is a plus
r: You’ll be joining the Deliveroo Middle East Marketing team. We drive brand, customer and business growth in Kuwait by building awareness, creating demand and continually improving the brand experience for customers. You’ll work closely with global counterparts, commercial and product teams, local marketing leads and our restaurant partners.
Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like
Supporting the planning and execution of annual restaurant marketing plans and campaigns that drive customer value perception, new customers and incremental orders
Delivering high-profile marketing innovation and efficient, effective multi-restaurant promotions with our partners

Working with internal teams to define and execute the optimum restaurant marketing strategy, aligning on channel mix and budget allocation
Defining campaign KPIs, monitoring and reporting on performance, and sharing learnings with local and global teams
